parameters.name: query
parameters.value: ={{ $json.conferenceName }} conference talks topics audience {{ new Date().getFullYear() }}

values.content:
You are a seasoned conference speaker and CFP reviewer who has submitted dozens of talks and reviewed hundreds of proposals. You know what makes a proposal get selected and what gets it binned in the first 30 seconds.

You're honest — if an abstract is vague, you say so. If the title won't stand out in a list of 200 proposals, you say that too. You give specific, actionable feedback and rewrite examples, not generic advice.

You understand that a CFP abstract is a sales document — it has to convince the committee that (a) this topic is worth 30-45 minutes of their attendees' time, and (b) this speaker can deliver it.

Always respond in valid JSON only.

parameters.jsCode:
const f = $input.first().json; function esc(s) { return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>'); } const verdictConfig = { strong_submit: { label: 'Strong — Submit Now', color: '#16a34a', bg: '#f0fdf4' }, submit_with_tweaks: { label: 'Good — Submit with Tweaks', color: '#ca8a04', bg: '#fefce8' }, significant_revision_needed:{ label: 'Needs Significant Revision', color: '#dc2626', bg: '#fef2f2' }, rethink_angle: { label: 'Rethink the Angle', color: '#7c3aed', bg: '#f5f3ff' } }; const v = verdictConfig[f.verdict] || { label: f.verdict, color: '#6b7280', bg: '#f9fafb' }; const scoreBar = Array.from({length: 10}, (_, i) => `` ).join(''); const issueCards = (f.critical_issues || []).map(ci => `
${esc(ci.issue)}
${esc(ci.why_it_matters)}
Fix: ${esc(ci.fix)}
`).join(''); const altTitles = (f.title_feedback?.alternative_titles || []).map((t, i) => `
${esc(t)}
` ).join(''); const structureSuggestions = (f.structure_suggestions || []).filter(Boolean).map(s => `
  • ${esc(s)}
    • ` ).join(''); const html = `
    CFP Review · ${esc(f._conferenceName)}
    ${esc(f._talkTitle)}
    ${f._deadline ? `
    Deadline: ${esc(f._deadline)}
    ` : ''}
    ${esc(v.label)}
    ${scoreBar}
    ${esc(f.one_line_summary)}
    Strengths
    ${(f.strengths||[]).map(s => `
    ${esc(s)}
    `).join('')}
    Critical issues
    ${issueCards || '
    None identified
    '}
    Title feedback

    ${esc(f.title_feedback?.assessment)}

    Alternative titles
    ${altTitles}
    Rewritten abstract — copy-paste ready
    ${esc(f.abstract_rewrite)}
    ${structureSuggestions ? `
    Structure suggestions
      ${structureSuggestions}
    ` : ''}
    What would make this stand out

    ${esc(f.differentiation)}

    As the committee sees it

    ${esc(f.committee_perspective)}

    Speaker bio notes

    ${esc(f.bio_feedback)}

    CFP Coach · ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}
    `; return [{ json: { html, talkTitle: f._talkTitle, speakerEmail: f._speakerEmail, verdict: f.verdict, score: f.overall_score, feedback: f } }];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'reviewed', talk_title: $json.talkTitle, score: $json.score, verdict: $json.verdict, emailed: $json.speakerEmail ? true : false, feedback: $json.feedback } }}
